text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: (—I can hear their voices.)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Hold on...!" "Go for it!!" 
"Keep runninggggggg!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Truth be told, I've heard them all along. 
Even when we were apart... they were 
always watching over me.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Daring Tact is loved. 
Ah... how blessed I truly am.)

text_block_list.name: Titleholder & Efforia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(—A gust of wind howls. 
I can feel the flame flickering 
violently...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Even so! Never...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
My flame will never go out!!!!! 
Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Daring Tact! 
Following up on her Queen Elizabeth II Cup 
triumph with yet another glorious victory!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact has blossomed— 
into an eternal flower that shall never 
wither!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: ...A flower that never withers, huh?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: No. She will simply bloom—again and again.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
So that is... 
"Daring Tact."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations!!" "That was 
incredible—!!" 
"Ah, thank you..." "Congrats~~!" 
"—Tact, I always believed in you...!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah...

Just then, Daring Tact stumbles. 
It must be exhaustion from the grueling 
race, but... 
looking closely, I can see how desperately 
she's fighting to stay on her feet.

—Quietly stepping up alongside her, 
I support her out of sight from the crowd. 
So that her pride and joy... will not 
fall.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Tore-san...
choice_data_list:
Hold your head high. Let's give it back—to 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes. 
Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone... 
Thank you... so much...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
For believing in me... for never giving up 
on me... 
For cheering me on—thank you...!

—Purely, with feelings unburdened and 
true. 
Daring Tact answered the cheers over and 
over, 
never stopping her heartfelt "thank yous."
choice_data_list:
(May this heartwarming sight be remembered 
forever.)

text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact will surely live on in 
history. 
As the horsegirl who became a beacon of 
warmth in the hearts of so many.

title: After the Japan Cup: A Gift of Thanks
